description: Template ICP. Replace with your real targeting before running live batches.
dealbreakers: Existing customer or open opportunity in CRM
Sanctioned country or on the suppression list

qualification.notes: Hard gates disqualify only on verified evidence of a dealbreaker; unknown values never disqualify, they hold. Missing evidence earns zero points and is listed in missingFields. Signal points decay linearly to zero at maxSignalAgeDays; only the strongest fresh signal counts. A pass needs score >= passThreshold and no missing required fields. Below holdThreshold is a poor fit and is disqualified with score 0. CRM and suppression dealbreakers are enforced at activation, not here.
